context:
Goal: settle Card in Hand's open choices, so Duo can plan the build.
Problem: a stray card that fits two envelopes is held. The next card from the same envelope can settle it, but only if the app knows a new envelope started.
Based on: decision duo-card-in-hand, your 12:25 picks (ruling); the fold and keyboard are unmeasured (measured: the runs failed at load 157).
Meanwhile: Duo plans the build and starts nothing until you answer.

designs.label: The stray screen: held, then decided (a)

holds: Duo's build plan for Card in Hand waits on this.

options.how: One tap says the next cards are from a new envelope; a held stray is decided by the next card.
options.label: Add New envelope
options.lose: One more control on mail day.

options.how: Held strays stay on the Suspense line until you pick.
options.label: No new control
options.lose: More strays wait for a manual pick.

ref: Duo design round 2, draft PR #144 (Card in Hand screens)
title: Add a New envelope control to decide held strays?
why: Strays mostly settle without your hand.
